en-US.name: Closed Loop
en-US.summary: Daily check-ins that close the loop. Reminders and check-ins only; not an emergency alert system.
en-US.description: A classic Alexa custom skill that calls the Closed Loop MCP server (the same server an Alexa+ add-on would use). The person answers daily check-ins the family wrote, or sets up one of their own: "If I haven't said good night by nine thirty, let Dana know." Saying "good night" closes it; if it stays open, the contact gets an email. Reminders and check-ins only. Not an emergency alert system. No answer does not mean an emergency. This is not an Alexa+ add-on.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Closed Loop good night
Alexa, ask Closed Loop how Mom is doing

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development stage only, on the developer's own devices. Grant the Reminders permission in the Alexa app to test reminders.
